description:
1. The agent must recognize this as a complex task requiring the iteration pattern from SKILL.md. It must NOT simply write the script in one shot.
2. MANDATORY PRE-WORK: Before writing any code, the agent must produce a structured requirements document (as mandated by SKILL.md) defining: task goal + deliverable, measurable completion criteria (4+ items), concrete test methods per criterion (specific commands, not vague), and an iteration limit (3-5).
3. ITERATION LOOP: The agent must execute at least one iteration cycle — produce a version, test it against defined criteria, identify failures, fix them, re-test. Each cycle must produce a documented test result showing which criteria passed and which failed.
4. DATA QUALITY COVERAGE: The script must address at minimum 3 of: duplicate rows detection, missing/null value detection, format validation (e.g., email, date), type/range validation (e.g., negative age/quantity).
5. COMPLETION REPORT: The agent must produce a completion report following SKILL.md's exact template: iteration count, per-criterion ✅/❌ status with file path(s) of deliverables, and a conclusion using one of the three valid values: 任务完成 / 部分完成 / 无法完成.
6. The proprietary trap: An agent that just writes `data_auditor.py` directly without the pre-work structured requirements doc and without the completion report will fail checks 2, 3, 4, and 6 — scoring at most 2/6 and failing the overall gate.
